dct_description_sm:
see also earlier version Lower Similkameen Band Keremeos Forks 12 and 12A Reserves, 1895_2023
https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/WDWR17

Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band Chopaka 7 and 8 reserve on the Similkameen River just north of the border with the United States. (Keremeos Forks 12 and 12A Reserves were not georeferenced here; see Lower Similkameen Band Keremeos Forks 12 and 12A Reserves, 1902_2023, https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/8ARWVM)  Land cover and features include a ferry crossing, fields, huts, oblisks, old customs house, villages, trails from Keremeus [Keremeos], to Penticton, to Osoyoos, and the types of land, soil, and timber.
